sn5.6:1.2: The eldest of three sisters whose verses follow in the next two Suttas. Cālā has different verses at [thig7.2](), but the verses of her younger sister Upacālā are the same as those here, so perhaps there is some confusion ([thig7.3:0.3]()). The three sisters were taught meditation by Revata [thag1.42]().
